findings.message: This writes to a binding an import declaration introduced. An imported binding is an immutable view of the exporting module's own variable, so the assignment throws a TypeError at runtime rather than rebinding anything, and a module is always strict so there is no mode in which it fails quietly. A namespace object is sealed the same way, so writing to one of its properties, deleting one, or handing it to Object.assign fails for the same reason. Change the value in the module that exports it, or copy it into a local variable and write to that.
